finding.description: Mixed banks assign distinct capacities to every option, so only the correct equation contains the prompt’s sole positive numeral. Copying that numeral bypasses sign and population-factor reasoning. It solves 14/14 fresh mixed questions and all 5 batch survivors. This finding does not reject the source’s legitimate all-capacity equilibrium-selection task.

finding.requested_change: Revise mixed-bank construction so wrong structural equations can share the stated equilibrium and learners must inspect sign/factor relationships. Require distinct equations rather than distinct constants. Preserve competing-capacity variation and the original length regressions, retain the new numeral-copy regression, and regenerate the batch.
